_meta._note: Chapter 52, final test (ch52-test, new). Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 6, from Docs/proposals/chapter-52-content-proposal.md. Twelve multiple-choice questions: clause boundaries (q01–02), phrase relationships (q03–04), noun and verb governance (q05–06), the condition and its nominal response (q07–08), two connected-text decisions from Ayat al-Kursi and 67:1 (q09–10) and one decision each from Al-Qadr and At-Tin (q11–12). Pass mark 80 %: 9/12 fails, 10/12 passes.
